input_references.role: Timestamped GPS points with map-matched road coordinates and OSM way identifiers

metadata.goal: Analyze location-visiting patterns and driving behavior across first and repeated visits.
metadata.category: Exploration bursts, familiarity, speed, and directness
metadata.dataset_description: A constructed WorldTrace case with 240 trajectories. Route geometries come from observed NYC WorldTrace records and retain map-matched coordinates and OSM way identifiers. User, visit sequence, time, mode, vehicle, and weather context are arranged to realize the stated analysis goal.

insight_list.insight: Although new-area visits account for only a small portion of the trajectory history, they are not evenly distributed over time.

plot.title: New-Location Visit Regularities: Insight 1
plot.description: The geographic panel uses map-matched WorldTrace route geometry; the question-specific statistical plot summarizes the corresponding pattern.

insight_list.question: What portion of the user’s trajectory history consists of new-area visits, and where do those visits occur in the sequence?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Locate all new-location visits along the ordered trip history and compare them with familiar returns.

insight_list.insight: Most new-area visits occur in several short sequences of consecutive explorations, separated by substantially longer periods dominated by returns to familiar areas.

plot.title: New-Location Visit Regularities: Insight 2
plot.description: The geographic panel uses map-matched WorldTrace route geometry; the question-specific statistical plot summarizes the corresponding pattern.

insight_list.question: Do new-area visits form short exploration sequences separated by longer periods dominated by familiar returns?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Inspect the trip indices and intervals separating successive new-location visits.

insight_list.insight: The more times the user visit the same location, the more likely the user drive faster to that location.

plot.title: New-Location Visit Regularities: Insight 3
plot.description: The geographic panel uses map-matched WorldTrace route geometry; the question-specific statistical plot summarizes the corresponding pattern.

insight_list.question: How does driving speed vary with the number of visits made to each location?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare location visit counts with mean driving speeds and quantify their association.
insight_list.code: g=df.groupby('visited_location').agg(visits=('trajectory_id','size'),speed=('mean_speed_kmh','mean')); print(g); print('correlation',g.visits.corr(g.speed)); plt.scatter(g.visits,g.speed); plt.xlabel('visits'); plt.ylabel('mean speed (km/h)'); plt.show()

insight_list.insight: The more times the user visit the same location, the more likely the user drive with smaller route directness rate to that location.

plot.title: New-Location Visit Regularities: Insight 4
plot.description: The geographic panel uses map-matched WorldTrace route geometry; the question-specific statistical plot summarizes the corresponding pattern.

insight_list.question: How does route directness vary with the number of visits made to each location?
insight_list.actionable_insight: Compare location visit counts with route-distance-to-straight-line ratios; smaller ratios indicate greater directness.
insight_list.code: g=df.groupby('visited_location').agg(visits=('trajectory_id','size'),ratio=('route_directness_ratio','mean')); print(g); print('correlation',g.visits.corr(g.ratio)); plt.scatter(g.visits,g.ratio); plt.xlabel('visits'); plt.ylabel('route / straight-line distance'); plt.show()
